note: Ordered onboarding content aligned with the product's progressive-disclosure model. Honest and maturity-tagged; introduces surfaces gradually rather than exposing all ~40 at once.

welcome.title: Welcome to NeuroPause
welcome.body: NeuroPause is an AI-native enterprise operating system — business modules, governed AI, knowledge, and operations in one desktop workspace. Two ideas to start with: your operational data is local-first (it lives on this device), and a thin cloud plane handles sign-in, the AI Store, and sync. This is a Release Candidate: pilot-ready, and honest about what's Preview.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Sign in via the backend with email/password (or OAuth, if your organization configured it). Sign-in requires the backend to be reachable.
steps.action: Sign in to reach the shell.

steps.title: Get your bearings
steps.body: Notice the three groups: Today, Business, and Advanced. Everyday surfaces are up front; advanced centers are revealed on demand. Press Command-K anytime to jump to any surface.
steps.action: Open the command palette with Command-K.

steps.title: Create your first record
steps.body: Open Business and pick a family you use (for example Finance or CRM). Create a record, then reopen it — it persists locally on this device. This is real local-first data, not a mock.
steps.action: Create and reopen one Business record.

steps.title: Save to memory, then find it
steps.body: Save something to AI Memory, then find it again from Knowledge search. Local lexical search always works; semantic ranking is optional.
steps.action: Save to AI Memory and retrieve it via Knowledge.

steps.title: Turn on AI (optional)
steps.body: To evaluate live AI, configure an AI provider in Settings — an Anthropic key or a local Ollama model. Without one, AI Workforce shows an honest deterministic fallback instead of a fabricated result.
steps.action: Configure an AI provider, or note the honest fallback.

steps.title: Run a governed AI action
steps.body: In AI Workforce, run one action end-to-end and inspect the approval and evidence trail: intent, governance, permission, execution, evidence.
steps.action: Run one governed action and review its evidence.

steps.title: Connect an integration (optional)
steps.body: In Connectors, connect one real integration. A connector is listed but not connectable until its OAuth app credentials are supplied — a 'not configured' state is honest.
steps.action: Connect one integration, or note the honest not-configured state.

steps.title: Explore Preview surfaces
steps.body: Advanced centers like Digital Twin, Industry, and Enterprise Marketplace run on seeded/in-memory data and are labelled Preview. Explore them as exploratory, not for production reliance.
steps.action: Open one Preview surface and note its banner.
